title: Nobody Told Me: Your Own Perfume

hooks.A: Your nose stops smelling your own perfume. On purpose.

lines.text: Ten minutes after spraying, I couldn't smell it. So I sprayed again. And again.
Turns out, your nose still detects it. Your brain just decides it's boring.
It tunes out smells that don't change, so it can notice new ones, like smoke or food.
But everyone around you? They smell all of it.
So don't re-spray just because you can't smell it. Step outside for a minute, or ask a friend.
Be honest. How many sprays are you wearing right now?
